item.title: A 21-Lesson Generative AI Course Offers a Faster Clone Option
item.description:
A 21-Lesson Generative AI Course Offers a Faster Clone Option

Microsoft Cloud Advocates’ 21-lesson course covers the fundamentals of building Generative AI applications. Its repository includes more than 50 language translations, which significantly increases download size; sparse checkout provides a faster download with what is needed to complete the course.

🔍 Course structure

  • Each lesson covers its own topic, so learners can start wherever they like.
  • “Learn” lessons explain a Generative AI concept.
  • “Build” lessons explain a concept and include code examples in Python and TypeScript when possible.

⚙️ Download option

The repository includes 50+ language translations, which significantly increases its download size. Sparse checkout can be used to get everything needed to complete the course with a much faster download.

#GenerativeAI #AIDevelopment #Python #TypeScript #DeveloperEducation
